evidence_gaps: product_id -> video list endpoint: not available without TIKHUB_TIKTOK_CREATOR_COOKIE (provider code 98001002 no login)
get_product_related_videos play_count: endpoint does not return play_count; per-video fetch_post_detail is required
product review -> video link: no video_id/aweme_id/item_id in 175 canonical reviews or 180 raw reviews; 0% joinable
video GMV / orders / conversion: only available to the logged-in creator via get_video_to_product_stats; not available for third-party videos
creator audience demographics (gender/age/region): only available to the logged-in creator via get_video_audience_stats
video captions/transcripts: TikHub has no subtitle endpoint; only Apify
18 SKU count and 22,140 sales: not present in current review raw; needs a product-detail source
exhaustive product video list: keyword search pagination is broken (cursor repeats page 1), so the product video index is a sample
creator follower_count in fetch_post_detail: null; fetch_user_profile is required
duplicate product listings: multiple product IDs share the same Momcozy YB001 / CozySupport Ergonest title; target-product video coverage may be undercounted because IDs are not merged

association_tiers.exact_target_product: anchor product_id == target; product and category baseline eligible
association_tiers.exact_other_product_category: anchor product_id is not target but the anchor title matches the belly-band category; category baseline eligible
association_tiers.exact_other_product_unrelated: anchor product_id is not target and the title is not belly-band; excluded from both baselines
association_tiers.text_match_brand_and_category: no anchor; brand and category words in caption/hashtags; excluded from baselines
association_tiers.text_match_category_only: no anchor; category words only; excluded from baselines
association_tiers.text_match_brand_only: no anchor; brand words only; excluded from baselines
association_tiers.none: no brand, category or anchor match; excluded
